% Pattern: number/counter. \newtheorem{note}[theorem]{Note} defines \note,
% which opens the environment without \begin and steps the shared counter,
% so the lemma after it is 1.3. Seen in the gold pilot (set X).
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 1.1
% want lemma-1 statement/lemma 1.3
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}[section]
\newtheorem{lemma}[theorem]{Lemma}
\newtheorem{note}[theorem]{Note}
\begin{document}
\section{One}
\begin{theorem} Every finite space is compact. \end{theorem}
\note
every space here is a topological space.

\begin{lemma} Every point is closed. \end{lemma}
\end{document}
